Algemene gegevens

Productnaam: Experia Box v10
Merk: ZTE
Fabrikantcode: ZXHN H369A
Bandbreedte: 300Mbps 2.4GHz, 1300Mbps 5GHz
WiFi-banden: Dual-band 802.11ac
 2.4GHz-band protocollen: b/g/n
 5GHz-band protocollen: a/n/ac
Router/WiFi-modem: WiFi-modem
Automatisch WiFi-kanaal kiezen: Ja
Gastnetwerk: Nee
Beveiligingstype: WPA, WPA2
Firewall: Ja

Interfaces

• WAN:
- 1 RJ14 DSL Line port
- 1 Gigabit Ethernet interface
• LAN: 
- 4-port autosensing 10/100/1000Base-T 
  and auto MDI/MDI-X Ethernet switch
- 2 FXS POTS interfaces
- 2 USB 3.0 host interface
- Wi-Fi complies with concurrent dual band IEEE 
  802.11b/g/n 2.4GHz and 802.11ac 5GHz standards

Buttons

• 1 restore factory default button (pinhole)
• 1 push button for WPS
• 1 push button for Wi-Fi on/off
• 1 push button for ECO on/off
• 1 push button for Herstel
• 1 power on/off switch

Power adapter

• 200-240 VAC (switched mode) power adapter
• European power plug

DSL Modem Specifications

• VDSL2 compliance: ITU-T G.993.2 (up to 30MHz profiles)
• VDSL2 Pair-Bonding compliance:
  ITU-T G.998.2 (up to 17MHz profiles)
• G.vector ITU-TG-993.5
• G.INP ITU-T G998.4
• UPBO ITU-T G993.2 amendment x
• 4 wire (2 pair) VDSL2 Bonding and VDSL2 Bonded Vectoring
• ADSL, ADSL2 and ADSL2+ compliance, Supports multi mode standards:
- ANSI T1.413 issue 2, ITU G.992.1 (G.DMT), ITU G.992.2 (G.Lite)
- ITU G.992.3 (G.DMT.bis), ITU G.992.4 (G.Lite.bis)
- ITU G.992.5

WAN Connection
• Auto WAN sensing ADSL, VDSL2, VDSL2 vectoring, VDSL2 pair bonding, 
  VDSL2 bonded vectoring, FTTH and 3G/4G
• PPPoE, PPPoA
• DHCP Client for Routed IPTV Connection
• Supports multiple WAN connection instances for different service
